description: Migrated from Linear CYB-22. CAIRF posters should be visible in Track Record as public storytelling assets.
acceptance_criteria: CAIRF posters are visible on the relevant program surface; users can browse and open poster assets cleanly.

title: CYB-35 Ship a first internal community metrics dashboard
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-35. Quarterly goals prioritize community visibility, insight, and better targeted engagement.
acceptance_criteria: AISSA staff can see community metrics in one internal surface; the view supports basic outreach and planning decisions.

title: CYB-32 Create a unified feedback inbox and reporting view
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-32. AISSA should inspect responses from integrated sources in one place instead of stitching spreadsheets manually.
acceptance_criteria: Staff can view feedback from integrated sources in one internal surface; filtering by source, program, event, and date is possible; export is available.

title: CYB-31 Integrate the chosen event platform as a first-class external source
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-31. Event data is a core AISSA operating surface and should feed the same shared model as feedback and CRM data.
acceptance_criteria: Chosen event platform is wired through a reusable integration path; event/context/attendance data can flow into the canonical engagement model; duplicate records are prevented.

title: CYB-30 Integrate Tally as a first-class external feedback source
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-30. Tally submissions should enter Track Record through a reusable integration path instead of manual cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Tally submissions land through a stable integration path; responses associate with people, contexts, or programs where possible; ingestion is reusable across forms.

title: CYB-29 Implement the event bus with Inngest
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-29. AISSA needs a durable event layer so integrations and modules can communicate through extensible domain events.
acceptance_criteria: Inngest is introduced as the event bus; core domain events can be emitted and consumed reliably; external integrations can target the event layer instead of bespoke glue.

title: CYB-28 Migrate Track Record to a context-registry pattern
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-28. The current context model makes it too expensive to add new modules and external event sources cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: Track Record uses a context-registry model; new context types can be introduced with lower schema friction; existing engagement and reporting behavior still works.

title: CYB-27 Deprecate community-edit in favour of account-based editing
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-27. The existing anonymous community-edit workflow is a stopgap that constrains future modularity.
acceptance_criteria: Community-edit is marked deprecated or removed from long-term product path; authenticated users can edit appropriate profile data; review behavior is re-scoped around authenticated users.

title: CYB-26 Adopt a single canonical account provider with WorkOS
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-26. AISSA needs one canonical member identity layer that works across modules and external integrations.
acceptance_criteria: WorkOS is the canonical account provider; member-facing identity no longer depends on anonymous community-edit; Track Record can resolve authenticated users to canonical person records.

title: CYB-18 Cut over aisafetysa.com to the standalone public website
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-18. Assign aisafetysa.com to the standalone public website deployment while preserving private Track Record and legacy rollback/reference deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Public domain resolves to apps/public-website; private Track Record URL remains protected; rollback/reference path is known; DNS/Vercel changes are documented.

title: CYB-5 Add canonical docs and docs-drift enforcement
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-5. Repo docs need a clear authoritative structure and drift checks for stale commands, deprecated paths, deploy references, and contradictions.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical docs are identified; drift checks catch stale critical references; agents know where durable domain, ADR, frontend, issue tracker, and verification guidance lives.

title: CYB-6 Add agent:doctor
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-6. Add a trusted root health-check command for runtime versions, install state, env expectations, generated artifacts, and browser availability.
acceptance_criteria: agent:doctor or equivalent command reports actionable environment readiness; failures identify the exact prerequisite or fix path; docs point agents to the command.

title: CYB-7 Add agent:smoke and app-local smoke commands
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-7. The monorepo needs canonical minimal smoke commands for autonomous work across the root and app surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Root and app-local smoke commands exist; they are fast enough for agents to use routinely; they verify real app surfaces rather than only compiling.

title: CYB-8 Turn architecture and taste into lintable policy
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-8. Architecture boundaries, deprecated docs references, Tailwind conventions, shadcn usage, and app boundaries should become mechanical checks where feasible.
acceptance_criteria: Lint or custom scripts catch high-value policy violations; false positives are acceptable enough for CI or preflight use; docs explain how to update the policy.

title: CYB-11 Add specialist review commands for done-means-reviewed
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-11. Passing ordinary checks is not the same as frontend, Payload safety, docs drift, CI scope, or architecture review.
acceptance_criteria: Specialist review commands exist for relevant domains; a combined agent review entrypoint documents when to use them; review output is suitable for handoff or PR evidence.

title: CYB-10 Make website browser validation a real review loop
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-10. Browser automation and visual diffing should become a meaningful local and CI review loop for website changes.
acceptance_criteria: Website route probing and visual verification run locally and in CI for relevant changes; output is agent-readable; the gate can start informational and become stricter once stable.

title: AI Safety SA Work
description: Migrated from Linear initiative AI Safety SA Work. Community tech, process optimizations, and partnership work for AISSA.
acceptance_criteria: Success means active AISSA Linear project backlog is represented in Beads with Linear references preserved and completed/stale work curated out.

title: Adopt Beads as shared AISSA work tracker

## Success Criteria
- Beads is initialized as a shared repo-local tracker with Dolt sync to origin.
- Agent guidance points to Beads and the project-local Beads skill.
- The initial Linear backlog is curated into Beads without blind sync.
- Legacy agent-notes are processed selectively into the correct durable homes.
- Transitional docs are cleaned up after setup and migration are proven.

description:
Review the migrated CYB-50 PRD and create child Beads issues for the executable CI/CD and local workflow validation changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The PRD has child issues for the concrete implementation slices.
- Each child issue has a clear affected surface, acceptance criteria, and verification path.
- Linear CYB-50 remains preserved as the external planning reference.
acceptance_criteria: Concrete child issues exist for the CYB-50 PRD, and the PRD itself is no longer treated as ready-to-run work.

title: CYB-25 Surface flagship-program content on the homepage or hero flow
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-25. The homepage should quickly signal AISSA strongest programs such as CAIRF.
acceptance_criteria: Homepage includes a clear featured-program story element for CAIRF or equivalent flagship work; content is public-safe and visually integrated.

title: CYB-37 Enrich the canonical engagement graph via integration architecture
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-37. CRM quality improves when external events, feedback, and future integrations feed the same shared model.
acceptance_criteria: Integrated external sources enrich person and context histories consistently; community metrics and CRM views become more complete as integrations land.

title: CYB-36 Add internal CRM fields and staff workflow on person records
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-36. AISSA needs more structured follow-through and relationship visibility beyond public display.
acceptance_criteria: Staff can track notes, follow-up state, or relationship-relevant metadata on people; internal CRM fields remain non-public.

title: CYB-34 Promote consented feedback into testimonials or proof points
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-34. Consented feedback should bridge operations data and public narrative surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Feedback with publishing consent can surface as testimonial candidates; admins can review and promote selected quotes; public attribution remains consent-safe.

title: CYB-33 Build reusable reporting views for feedback and event outcomes
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-33. Integration value comes from repeatable reporting, not only raw ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: AISSA can generate repeatable reporting views for programs and events without manual spreadsheet stitching; summary metrics and raw records are both accessible.

title: CYB-57 Remove remaining ad hoc public website surface drift
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-57. Do a final standardization pass after main migrations so remaining wrappers and bands either use shared primitives or are justified one-offs.
acceptance_criteria: A scan finds no unjustified ad hoc section wrappers or surface variants; any intentional exceptions are documented near the implementation or in frontend styling guidance.

description: Migrated from Linear CYB-56. Standardize repeated card, table, resource, event, and CTA surface treatments across the public website.

description: Migrated from Linear CYB-55. Convert /programs, /events, /research, and /get-involved index pages to the standard surface vocabulary.
acceptance_criteria: Index pages share heading, spacing, container, and background conventions; distinct content layouts remain legible; relevant unit and browser checks pass.

title: CYB-54 Migrate homepage sections to standard surfaces

acceptance_criteria: Homepage sections use shared surface primitives; Mission, Programs, Research, Events, Team, stats, partner banner, and CTA keep a coherent visual rhythm; browser verification passes.

acceptance_criteria: Public website E2E starts the needed apps; smoke checks exercise launch-critical routes; CI path filters run the right checks for public website changes.

acceptance_criteria: PRD context is preserved in Beads; remaining executable work is represented as child issues; completed implementation slices are not re-imported as open work.
close_reason: Imported completed Linear PRD as planning context; remaining open work lives in child issues.

description: Migrated from Linear CYB-9. Re-check whether heavyweight or contradictory app guidance remains after the repo-level CLAUDE/AGENTS and Beads updates.
acceptance_criteria: Current app guidance is audited; stale or duplicate agent docs are removed or reduced to maps; durable depth lives in the correct docs or skills.

title: CYB-12 Define an agent-legible UI contract for critical flows
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-12. Critical user and admin flows need stable headings, labels, landmarks, and selectors so browser automation can verify them reliably.
acceptance_criteria: A short UI contract exists; critical flows use stable accessible labels/landmarks/selectors; relevant tests or browser checks depend on the contract.

description: Migrated from Linear CYB-13. The admin community review/apply loop needs stronger browser or integration coverage for consequential mixed approval and conflict cases.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage exercises mixed approvals, conflict handling, and apply outcomes; failures are deterministic enough for agents to diagnose; tests are documented in the app verification path.

title: CYB-14 Standardize validation artifacts in agent-readable form
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-14. Validation outputs for doctor, smoke, Playwright, visual diff, and docs drift are currently fragmented.
acceptance_criteria: Validation commands write predictable summaries and artifacts; CI preserves or reports them; agents can locate outputs without inspecting command internals.

description: Migrated from Linear CYB-16. Fresh clones and worktrees should encode hidden prerequisites through dependable setup and validation commands.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh worktree can run the documented setup/validation path without tribal knowledge; generated artifacts and prerequisite builds are handled by scripts or package tasks.

description: Migrated from Linear CYB-48. Review CI and pre-commit lint scope so local hooks and pipeline checks do not run unnecessarily broad work.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-commit and CI lint behavior is explicitly scoped; the repo docs explain what each hook checks; broad checks remain available through deliberate commands.

title: CYB-50 PRD: Simplify CI/CD and add local workflow validation
description: Migrated from Linear CYB-50. Planning artifact for simplifying AISSA CI/CD and making local workflow validation understandable before PRs and merges.
acceptance_criteria: PRD is reviewed in Beads; actionable implementation issues are created as children before execution; Linear link remains preserved.

title: Clean up Beads migration docs after setup is proven
description:
After the Beads setup and sync path are proven, update the repo docs to remove transitional caveats, point agents at the verified workflow, and keep CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/issue-tracker.md, and ADR guidance consistent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- CLAUDE.md and docs/agents/issue-tracker.md describe the proven Beads workflow.
- Transitional wording from setup is removed or clearly marked historical.
- ADR guidance remains consistent with the actual Beads configuration.
- Completion checklist and verification guidance match the repository workflow.

title: Process legacy agent-notes archive selectively
description:
Review agent-notes as a read-only legacy archive and extract only durable value: actionable work into Beads, domain terms into CONTEXT.md, ADR-worthy decisions into docs/adr, and stable guidance into ordinary docs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Legacy notes are reviewed without creating new normal-work notes in agent-notes.
- Actionable unresolved work is captured in Beads.
- Domain terms are moved to CONTEXT.md when useful.
- ADR-worthy decisions are moved to docs/adr.
- Stable operating guidance is moved to ordinary docs.
- Obsolete or duplicate material is left archived rather than reintroduced.
